answer: Seed every identity's workload with hidden canary tasks whose answers are already known, each disguised differently: one weighs a marble, one counts trees in an orchard photograph. Independent agents err randomly, but clones run by one mind share the same blind spots and miss the same traps in the same way. When error patterns correlate far above chance, treat those accounts as one actor, anchor their combined reward to a single identity, and audit the cluster. A shared playbook now betrays the farm that runs it.
